description: This file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class for rendering the home screen's vertical list of sections in an Android app. It manages different view types such as headers, banners, and content rows, including their view holders and binding logic. It also contains data models for the sections.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering sections (header, banner, content rows) in the home screen's RecyclerView.

classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: View holder for the header section, including brand title and top navigation bar.

classes.name: BannerSectionVH
classes.description: View holder for banner sections displaying a horizontal list of banners with snapping and focus behavior.

classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: View holder for content row sections showing a title and horizontally scrolling list of cards.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits the list of sections to the adapter.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type for the item at a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder at a given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Bind method in each ViewHolder class for populating views with data.
